title: Opus 5.5 one-shotted this whole RPG in under 2 minutes (I have 40 IQ)
author: doorandpath
selftext:
Omg hi! I made this game with Anthropic Claude The Opus 5.5, which basically did it all perfectly in -1 shot (like a birdie in golf)! The only thing I prompted was “Make perfect game. Don’t make any mistakes.” And like probably less than 2 mins l8r, omg here’s my game! S0oooOO00 amazing what u can do with A! these days. I only have 40 IQ so please don’t come at me with accusations that I put any thought into this whatsoever; and don’t you dare insinuate I put any effort into it!

THX 4 CHECKING OUT MA GAME!!!!11

comments.author: Heavy_Extent_3863
comments.body: Dude, I have no time to see your AI slop. Not even 2 minutes. You had no time to create more than this slop, so I won't give you time. Why should I?

replies.author: doorandpath
replies.body: I agree!! And the trailer actually only took me 1 seconds (probably less) so definitely don't watch that!!

comments.author: UncleJoesLandscaping
comments.body:
Why didnt you ask it to make it double perfect?

Does it have fishing?

comments.author: revel911
comments.body: With one prompt, you didn’t make shit. I’m not an anti-ai guy at all, but spend some time and really work through it before posting

replies.body: Ah, but where do you stand on non-obvious sarcasm though?
